name: logo-land
description: Create and refine logos with native Codex image generation, guided palettes, symbol-plus-text layouts, and verified PNG delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Your next logo starts with a conversation.
interface.longDescription: Create eight logo types through conversation. Choose or constrain colors, extract reference palettes, arrange symbols and lettering, refine exact originals, and export PNGs with sampled color evidence.
defaultPrompt: $logo-land Help me create a logo that fits my brand.
Keep #247A52 and suggest warmer companion colors for the selected logo.
Create a symbol-plus-text logo with the symbol above the exact brand name.
Create a transparent PNG logo and preserve intentional white lettering.
Resume my saved logo project and export the selected reviewed PNG.
